[[Portal Wraith]]s are [[Phantom]]s, summoned by the [[Undead Lich]], that maintain the portals and [[Chaos Rift]]s which sends the Lich's forces across the world. When the Portal Wraiths guarding a portal die, it closes. They almost always have an escort to protect them.

==Notes==
*Unlike other undead, they do not take double [[holy damage]].
*While in [[Normal mode]] they are uncoordinated, in [[Hard mode]] they can [[spike]] a target with three copies of Chain Lightning at once, often killing 3 party members in an instant. Anti-caster [[shutdown]]s are very effective.
